listen_addr.description: IP addresses on which OpenNTPD will listen for NTP queries. Use [0.0.0.0] to listen on all interfaces (⚠️ not recommended for production).

allowed_networks.description: List of networks allowed to synchronize with this NTP server. Each item defines a network address and optional subnet mask (as CIDR or dotted quad).

mask.description: Subnet mask or CIDR suffix (e.g., 255.255.255.0 or /24)

ldap_uri.description: URI of the LDAP server (e.g., ldap://ldap.example.com or ldaps://ldap.example.com:636)

ldap_base_dn.description: Base DN under which LDAP time source entries are stored.

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN used to bind to the LDAP server (service account with read access).

ldap_bind_pw.description: Password for the LDAP bind DN. Leave empty to use external authentication (e.g., SASL/GSSAPI) or read from secure file.

ldap_search_filter.description: LDAP search filter to find valid time sources (e.g., servers advertising time service).

ldap_tls_ca_dir.description: Directory containing CA certificates for LDAP over TLS (ldaps://). Use '' for default system CA store.

ldap_tls_reqcert.description: TLS certificate verification level for LDAP: 'never', 'allow', 'try', or 'demand'.

min_poll_interval.description: Minimum interval (seconds) between queries to LDAP-sourced time servers. Range: 15–3600.

max_poll_interval.description: Maximum interval (seconds) between queries to LDAP-sourced time servers. Range: 60–86400.

step_threshold.description: Time offset (seconds) above which the clock will step (jump) instead of slewing. Lower values = gentler corrections. Range: 0.001–10.0.

fallback_servers.description: Static NTP server hostnames/IPs used if LDAP returns no sources. Empty list = default pool.ntp.org servers will be used.

leapfile.description: Path to a leap seconds file (e.g., /usr/share/zoneinfo/leap-seconds.list). If empty, system default is used.
